candidate.user_input: What is the process for obtaining an exception to use external storage devices on company-managed devices, and how is encryption handled?
candidate.reference: The use of removable and external storage devices such as USB flash drives and external backup drives on company-managed devices is not allowed and is blocked by default. An exception request may be opened here if there is a business need for the use of an external storage device. Corporate Security will coordinate with requestors to determine the most suitable encryption-enabled device and configure encryption and password protection.

source_conditions: Use of removable and external storage devices (USB flash drives, external backup drives) on company-managed devices is not allowed and is blocked by default.
An exception request may be opened if there is a business need for the use of an external storage device.
Exception requests are submitted via a specific link (https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/gl-security/corp/issue-tracker/-/issues/new?issuable_template=usb_exception).
Corporate Security will coordinate with requestors to determine the most suitable encryption-enabled device.
Corporate Security will configure encryption and password protection.
